81950.subject: What Drives L1 Value
81950.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/eaa70932-7ce4-467e-b338-a662ed575d6a/0xR_NL_Banner_Heading_Wordmark.jpg?t=1776775276)
Caption: 

What drives L1 value?

The short answer: On any horizon a trader cares about, L1 tokens trade on BTC beta. I regressed monthly log changes in each L1's market cap on BTC, then added the four onchain series (REV in native units, active addresses, DEX volume and stablecoin supply). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/145b7e5f-5ff9-4a40-9aaa-025f65e1dced/image.png?t=1793803857)
Caption: 

Here’s the long answer. USD-denominated metrics tend to flatter fundamentals because a fee paid in the native token is worth more when it rallies, and TVL is largely the native token marked to market.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/5b3bf9b7-8597-43ed-8e29-508652a9906b/image.png?t=1793803858)
Caption: 

Ethereum is the clearest break between REV and value. Trailing-12M REV was $3.3B the week of Dencun and $1.3B by August 2025, down 60%. Market cap went the other way, $460B to $540B. This is a policy choice, not a demand collapse. Blob fees and gas limit increases cut the price of L1 blockspace by design. Instead, the 2025 rally ran on ETF and treasury company demand (discussed later). 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/6c20e34c-503b-4874-b075-f3c6992357a9/image.png?t=1793803859)
Caption: 

Solana is the case where the two lines do travel together. Trailing REV and market cap both rose about 15x from January 2023 and peaked in the same week, at $2.50B and $130B. Both have since fallen to $400M and $58B.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8c034b54-aef5-47f7-b09e-bac6fc043979/image.png?t=1793803859)
Caption: 

I then looked at Active Addresses and DEX Volumes. Active addresses and market cap drift together over a cycle, most clearly on Solana and TRON. However, week to week the link is significantly weaker and the divergences are large. Since January 2022, ETH's addresses are up 26% while its market cap is down 34%, and Solana's addresses are up 17x against a 17% rise in market cap. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/ba73d7f1-f2a9-4dc8-aeca-0c0523e6fb97/image.png?t=1793803861)
Caption: 

DEX volume tracks market cap more closely than addresses, especially on Solana, where both rose from the 2023 low and peaked together. But DEX volume is in USD, so _part_ of that fit is the token price itself. As tokenized assets rise in volume share, we can test if this rel
